summary: All 15 claims are faithful: every condition traces to the red box or the Assess table, in the right rule and role, with no invented, distorted or misplaced content and every SNOMED concept resolving exactly. The only debatable rendering is 'Rapid worsening of symptoms' as the heart failure disorder qualified Worsening/Rapid, which is a fair approximation with no clearly closer finding concept. Outside the checked rules, two pieces of page logic are not encoded: footnote 3 says 'shock likely' when SBP < 80, pulse >= 100, RR > 30, confusion/restlessness or weakness (an 'X likely' that the brief says should be a probable diagnosis), and the Assess table's same-day referral triggers (fainting/blackouts, new irregular pulse) and pregnancy referral have no rule.
